Unihealth Hospitals achieves another clinical milestone in Advanced Minimally Invasive Surgery

Unihealth Hospitals Limited (NSE Emerge: UNIHEALTH) announces that UMC Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, has successfully treated a 33-year-old patient with a large walled-off pancreatic necrosis, a serious delayed complication following severe pancreatitis.

The complex case was successfully managed by Dr. Harsh Sheth, Consultant Bariatric & GI Laparoscopic Surgeon, using an advanced laparoscopic minimally invasive approach, avoiding the need for a conventional large open surgery. 

This achievement further strengthens UMC Hospitals, Navi Mumbai’s capabilities in Gastrointestinal, Laparoscopic and Pancreatic Surgery, and adds to its growing portfolio of advanced clinical interventions.

In recent months, UMC Hospitals has achieved several notable milestones, including Robotic Knee Replacement, IVUS-guided Cardiac Intervention and Navi Mumbai’s 1st Bilateral Robotic Direct Anterior Approach Total Hip Replacement.

Unihealth Hospitals achieves another clinical milestone in Advanced Minimally Invasive Surgery

Unihealth Hospitals Limited (NSE Emerge: UNIHEALTH) announces that UMC Hospitals, Navi Mumbai, has successfully treated a 33-year-old patient with a large walled-off pancreatic necrosis, a serious delayed complication following severe pancreatitis.

The complex case was successfully managed by Dr. Harsh Sheth, Consultant Bariatric & GI Laparoscopic Surgeon, using an advanced laparoscopic minimally invasive approach, avoiding the need for a conventional large open surgery. 

This achievement further strengthens UMC Hospitals, Navi Mumbai’s capabilities in Gastrointestinal, Laparoscopic and Pancreatic Surgery, and adds to its growing portfolio of advanced clinical interventions.

In recent months, UMC Hospitals has achieved several notable milestones, including Robotic Knee Replacement, IVUS-guided Cardiac Intervention and Navi Mumbai’s 1st Bilateral Robotic Direct Anterior Approach Total Hip Replacement.

YATRA ONLINE Q1 ; GROSS BOOKINGS GROW 16.5%, HOTEL ROOM NIGHTS SURGE ~30% — MICE BUSINESS IMPACTS EBITDA

• ✈️ Gross bookings grew 16.5% YoY to ₹2,100.7 Cr, with total Air & H&P transactions up 12.2%

• 🏨 Room nights jumped ~30% YoY, supported by continued expansion of hotel supply

• 💰 Gross Margin (RLSC) grew 6.1% YoY to ₹122.7 Cr

• 📉 EBITDA declined 45.6% YoY to ₹13.2 Cr, impacted by Middle East conflict-related weakness in international MICE and lower airline-related income

• 🏢 Added 53 corporate customers with annual billable potential of ₹222.3 Cr; MSME-focused team added 30+ new clients

• 🤖 AI-powered expense management platform RECAP reached 20 cumulative customers

• 📈 Q2 MICE pipeline is 50%+ higher than Q1, indicating potential recovery in activity

• 🌍 Signed a 7-year strategic partnership with Kanoo Travel, marking a major international expansion of Yatra’s enterprise travel technology platform into the Middle East

UVS HOSPITALITY ACQUIRES 34.76% STAKE IN CALCIO RESTAURANTS VIA ₹23.87 CR SHARE SWAP

• 🍽️ Acquired 34.76% stake in Calcio Restaurants Private Limited on a fully diluted basis

• 💰 Acquisition consideration stands at ₹23.87 Cr, entirely through a share swap

• 📊 UVS Hospitality allotted 23,87,257 equity shares on a preferential basis to Calcio shareholders

• 🏨 Calcio operates in the hotels & restaurants business and has a presence in Mumbai

• 📈 Calcio reported FY25 turnover of approximately ₹5.20 Cr, versus ₹2.78 Cr in FY24

• 🤝 Transaction is aimed at business consolidation, operational synergies, balance-sheet strengthening and future growth opportunities

🟢 Outlook: Positive – Strategic investment expands UVS Hospitality's exposure to the restaurant business, with potential operational synergies and growth opportunities.

FRONTIER SPRINGS Q1 ; MAINTAINS ₹500 CR FY27 REVENUE GUIDANCE, EXPECTS Q1 EXECUTION SHORTFALL TO RECOVER

• ⚠️ Q1 performance impacted by industrial gas shortages and delays in procurement of air spring bellows, resulting in lower capacity utilisation

• ✅ Supply disruptions now resolved; plant operations and supply chains have fully normalised entering Q2

• 📈 Demand remains firm across business verticals with a strong order pipeline

• 💰 Softening raw material prices expected to support margins in coming quarters

• 🎯 Management maintains FY27 gross revenue guidance of ₹500 Cr and expects deferred Q1 execution to be recovered during the year

• 🚆 Coil springs & air springs demand remains steady, supported by railway procurement; forging business seeing improving orders

• 🛠️ Received RDSO approval as a developmental vendor for FIBA systems; preparing samples covering 25 coach sets for a 12-month trial

• 🚀 Successful FIBA trials could pave the way for commercial-scale orders, creating a new long-term growth opportunity

- EBITDA margin expanded sharply.

- India ASP reached ₹1,856.
- Premiumisation drove higher ASP.

Operational Highlights
- Eye tests grew 39.8% YoY.
- Eyewear volumes grew 25.7% YoY.
- Strong store expansion continued.
- Revenue growth remained broad-based.
- India continued strong same-store growth.
- International business delivered faster growth.
- Customer acquisition remained robust.

Cash Flow & Capital Efficiency
- Operating Cash Flow ₹297 Cr.
- Capex stood at ₹207 Cr.
- Operating cash flow exceeded capex.
- Positive Free Cash Flow generated.
- ROCE improved to 23.2%.
- ROCE increased from 14.6% in FY26.
- Higher EBIT supported ROCE improvement.
- Disciplined capital allocation continued.

Key Positives
- Strong revenue growth.
- EBITDA growth outpaced revenue growth.
- PAT growth remained exceptional.
- Product margin crossed 70%.
- Strong India SSSG.
- Healthy international growth.
- Premiumisation improving ASP.
- Strong store expansion.

The Momentum Decoder: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (+60% in 1 month)

Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd (NSE:KALYANKJIL) surged after posting a massive 46% jump in quarterly revenue, which triggered aggressive institutional buying despite some minor margin pressure. Smart money completely absorbed the initial post-earnings profit booking near ₹568, driving a sharp volume-backed recovery that pushed the stock to finish strong at ₹610.

Bottom Line: The structural growth is impressive, but chasing a vertical 60% rally leaves no margin of safety; wait for a healthy pullback toward ₹570 before considering new entries.

Yield Spike & Global Impact 🌍

The US 30Yr Treasury yield hit 5.28%, a high unseen since 2007. The US-Iran conflict pushed WTI Crude from $67 to $115/barrel before settling near $76.

Rising crude halted the inflation decline, sparking hawkish Federal Reserve shifts. The 10Yr Treasury yield has strong support at 4.5% and could hit 5%. The Dollar Index remains firm near 98.

Tactical Play: Elevated yields strengthen the USD but crush Gold and emerging equities. Gold ($4,341) faces downside risk to $3,800. The Nifty 50 and Indian Rupee will face bearish corrections.

🎯 Bottom Line: Oil-driven inflation fears have reignited US Treasury yields. Expect a strong US Dollar, capped upside for Gold, and delayed rallies in global equities until yields decisively fall.

NUVAMA ON TITAN

Rating: HOLD (Downgraded from BUY) , Target Price: ₹5,241 (Earlier ₹5,030)

• Q1 FY27 performance was strong with revenue up 36% YoY, EBITDA up 57% and net profit up 65%

• Jewellery revenue grew 43% to ₹15,900 Cr; domestic jewellery revenue rose 38%, with like-for-like growth of 33%

• Jewellery EBIT included an inventory gain of around ₹370 Cr; MTM inventory benefit was around 75–80 bps

• CaratLane revenue grew around 41%; EBIT margin improved sharply to 11.5% from 6.6%

• International jewellery revenue jumped 136%, but the segment reported an ₹8 Cr EBIT loss amid GCC geopolitical disruptions

• Watches and eyewear businesses both grew 22%

• Nuvama expects MTM benefits to moderate over the next 2–3 quarters, while customs-duty benefits could continue for another two quarters

• Despite strong fundamentals, the recent share-price rally has reduced upside potential, prompting the downgrade to HOLD.
